provenance.method: Document existing I0/I1 product controls against Representation Router principles; not a visual or scientific certification

question: Can Brian distinguish what each person actually received from analyst knowledge, then trace separate report, technical and consent consequences?
primary: linked actor/analyst context and chronological event/state comparison
rationale: Exact input records answer what a policy received. Separate analyst events and state answer what actually changed. A graph alone cannot establish absence of private words from a prompt.

compositionPlan.primary_element: Selected person and per-round actual input
secondary_elements: Chronological attempts and canonical event changes
Separate condition, exposure, stance, assent and hold records
compositionPlan.interaction: Read-only Context view and Person selectors; input records expand without model calls or memory changes. A retained share replays its recorded rounds.
compositionPlan.color: Blue selection, orange gaps/refusals, grey context; explicit text labels.

availability: implemented product controls; complete inspected production I0/I1 demonstration remains pending
alternatives: A global summary would mix privileged facts with actor knowledge.
A graph can supplement causal order but cannot replace exact messages and values.
avoid: A passing test count as proof of actor knowledge
Privileged provenance shown as an actor observation
A chosen social ending as an acceptance condition
verification: Source and contract checks inspected; production render and human comprehension remain separate evidence.
